scripts.dev:all: npm --prefix app1 run dev & npm --prefix app2 run dev & npm --prefix portal run dev & wait
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix app1 run build & npm --prefix app2 run build & npm --prefix portal run build & wait
scripts.start:all: npm --prefix app1 run start & npm --prefix app2 run start & npm --prefix portal run start & wait
scripts.stop:all: for p in 3000 3002 3010; do pid=$(lsof -tiTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pid" ]; then kill $pid; fi; done
scripts.lint:all: npm --prefix app1 run lint && npm --prefix app2 run lint && npm --prefix portal run lint
